The '''Mannett Shore''' was a region of beach on the coast of [[Avilatan]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The Mannett Shore was the western beach of Avilatan, and the island of [[Mannett Point]] was off the coast there.
